Saatchi & Saatchi


Visit saatchi.com

A few months ago I was lucky to get involved in this project. Saatchi & Saatchi have +-140 offices around the world and wanted to create a common platform where they can unite and display their work. Working on a website such a scale, always brings some complications, but is exciting at the same time.

I was first re-concepting the internal site of Saatchi, but got put on a hold. Later on they asked me to translate those designs and structures, to the global Saatchi&Saatchi website.
First are screens of the initial designs. Latter are the final Saatchi Global ones.

Disclaimer: Header-images are used as a place-holder and concepting purposes,
they are not related to Saatchi&Saatchi in any way.
